meta.name: The Altruists
meta.description: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

videos.title: Inappropriate Relationships
videos.overview: Years before the fraud, the lies and the coverup, Sam and Caroline meet in New York. As their romance heats up, so does their appetite for risking it all.

videos.title: 7 Versions of the Truth
videos.overview: The math is clear: Sam and Caroline must agree on their primary focus. A bachelorette party raises questions about the past and FTX's balance sheet.

videos.title: Words with Friends
videos.overview: Sam lies to Caroline and the team as a fledgling FTX faces an existential threat. Later in the Bahamas, one of his oldest friends discovers the truth.

videos.title: Good Guys
videos.overview: As Sam pursues an endorsement from his idol, FTX faces a choice between ethics and survival. In 2022, a reporter puts Caroline under the microscope.

videos.title: Game Nights
videos.overview: Sam and Caroline wonder: What if crossing the line isn't so bad? As Nishad weighs his options in the Bahamas, another player plots a risky chess move.

videos.title: The Duck
videos.overview: Sam's ex-best friend tells his side of the story. All aboard Trabucco's yacht for a tragic tale of rubber ducks, One Direction and broken hearts.

videos.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
videos.overview: Sam and Caroline's bond is tested under crisis. When the press flocks to the Bahamas, it's time for some game theory, but real life isn't a math problem.

videos.title: God Mode
videos.overview: The feds pressure FTX's inner circle as wild rumors swirl. The crypto empire comes crashing down, but the $8B question looms: Who's going to prison?
